cues: Quiet breathing moves the tidal volume, about five hundred millilitres.
Take the deepest breath you can: the extra is the inspiratory reserve, about three thousand.
Breathe out as hard as you can: the expiratory reserve, about eleven hundred.
And about twelve hundred millilitres can never be breathed out at all: the residual volume.
text: A spirometer records each breath. Quiet breathing moves the tidal volume, about five hundred millilitres. Take the deepest breath you can: the extra is the inspiratory reserve, about three thousand. Breathe out as hard as you can: the expiratory reserve, about eleven hundred. And about twelve hundred millilitres can never be breathed out at all: the residual volume.
